text:
Ana (PM): quick sync please — ACME asked for Private onramp MVP: per-tenant SLA p95 <=150ms, burst to 2x baseline, and HSM-backed key storage. need to decide scope and what we promise for launch.
Matt (Eng): that latency is aggressive for on-prem with large models. what's the expected qps and avg seq length from the account?
Ana (PM): convo with ACME sales: baseline 60 qps, 512 tokens average, occasional spikes to 180 qps. they want a staging window next quarter.
Sasha (Runtime): 512 tokens makes KV-cache size big — continuous batching + prefix cache helps but 150ms p95 is tight. if we limit to a 7B quantized runtime we might hit it. otherwise we need prewarmed dedicated GPUs.
Lina (Infra): prewarm + regional burst requires reserved capacity or fast autoscale. for Private we can offer a "burst pool" but ops cost rises. network egress within customer VPC also adds 10-30ms depending on topology.
Rajat (Security): HSM (externally managed) adds HSM roundtrips on key unwrap. we can mitigate by caching DEKs per-session; threat model ok if we limit cache TTL and add attestation. need product acceptance on key-rotation rules.
Jordi (ProductOps): propose an MVP acceptance checklist: 
- [ ] SLA statement + penalties (internal)
- [ ] Supported model families for MVP (e.g., 7B quantized only)
- [ ] Autoscale / burst policy documented
- [ ] KMS/HSM integration doc + threat model
- [ ] Test harness & perf benchmark runbook
Can teams own these individually?
Matt (Eng): I can own the supported-models doc and perf harness. Will need 2 eng-weeks to prototype 7B quant path and KV cache tuning.
Sasha (Runtime): I'll add runtime knobs: continuous-batching defaults, kv cache TTL, and quant profile. estimate 1.5 weeks + 1 week perf tuning with ACME traces.
Lina (Infra): infra needs spec for burst pool (capacity numbers, prewarm ttl) and VPC networking patterns. estimate 1 week to sketch + 2 weeks to implement staging infra.
Rajat (Security): I'll draft HSM integration checklist and rollout gating for key rotation. need to validate with legal on export controls. 1 week for initial doc.
Ana (PM): good. can we map minimal in/out decisions now so product can set expectations to ACME? my suggested in-scope for MVP: 7B quantized only, dedicated burst pool up to 2x, DEK caching with 5m TTL, SLA scoped to hosted latency inside customer VPC (excluding cross-region network issues). out-of-scope: support for models >13B, per-request HSM unwraps (no), multi-region active-active.
Matt (Eng): fine with that. add a guardrail: if avg seq >800 during stress we'll auto-fail to a lower SLA and notify customer.
Sasha (Runtime): agree. add runtime metric annotations for p95 by model and by tenant. we need a canary dataset from ACME to validate quality/regressions.
Jordi (ProductOps): I'll make a tidy acceptance matrix and update the onboarding playbook. Can someone open a cross-team ticket with owners and dates?
deploy-bot: created ticket #PRD-1328 (ACME private-onramp MVP) and added owners: Matt, Sasha, Lina, Rajat, Jordi.
Ana (PM): thanks — propose target: prototype + perf runs in 3 sprints, soft launch to ACME staging at end of sprint 3. if any team needs to push, surface by EOD Wed so we can renegotiate schedules.
Lina (Infra): flag: infra calendar has two infra releases overlapping sprint 2; may block implementation. I’ll put up a calendar invite to triage.
Matt (Eng): noted. if infra can't shift, we can run perf tuning against a hosted staging cluster to unblock runtime changes.
Rajat (Security): legal scheduled review likely in sprint 2; if that slips, HSM gating may push launch. I'll escalate with Legal now.
Ana (PM): ok — summary action items: Matt: models+perf harness (2w). Sasha: runtime knobs + perf tuning (2.5w). Lina: burst pool spec + stage infra (3w). Rajat: HSM checklist + legal liaison (1w). Jordi: acceptance matrix + onboarding doc (1w). I'll own customer communication and milestone signoff.
Sasha (Runtime): one more thing — we should capture fallback policy in case capacity constrained: automatic degrade to quantized CPU-serving or reduced seq-length window. want a short snippet for the rollout doc.
Matt (Eng): simple config we can add to rollout playbook:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  when_queue_ms: 200
  prefer_model: "7B-quant"
  degrade_seq_cap: 384
  notify: true
```
Jordi (ProductOps): perfect — I'll include that in PRD.
Ana (PM): thanks team. please update ticket #PRD-1328 with any time changes. syncing again Fri 10am to lock launch readout. :calendar: :thumbsup:
